title: get_health_returns_service_status
description: Verify that the GET /health endpoint returns a 200 status with a status string indicating the service is running and does not require authentication.

title: get_api_organizations_workspace_name_availability_checks_name_availability
description: Test GET /api/organizations/workspace-name-availability with a valid workspaceName query parameter returns 200 with isAvailable boolean indicating if the workspace name is available for the authenticated user.

title: post_api_organizations_creates_new_organization
description: Test POST /api/organizations with valid organization profile and feature selections creates a new organization and returns 201 with organizationId, name, and workspaceName for an authenticated user.

title: post_api_organizations_organizationid_invitations_invites_user_with_permission
description: Verify POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/invitations with email and role by an authorized admin user returns 200 with membershipId, email, and role; and returns 403 if the caller lacks InviteUser permission.

title: post_api_organizations_memberships_membershipid_accept_invitation_accepts_invitation
description: Verify POST /api/organizations/memberships/{membershipId}/accept-invitation allows the invited user to accept the invitation and returns 200 with confirmation message.

title: post_api_organizations_memberships_membershipid_accept_request_accepts_join_request_with_permission
description: Verify POST /api/organizations/memberships/{membershipId}/accept-request by an admin with AcceptRequest permission returns 200 with confirmation message; returns 403 if caller lacks permission.

title: get_api_organizations_organizationid_configuration_credit_terms_lists_credit_terms_with_permission
description: Test GET /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/credit-terms returns 200 with a list of credit terms for a user with View permission; returns 403 if lacking permission.

title: post_api_organizations_organizationid_configuration_credit_terms_creates_credit_term_and_handles_duplicates
description: Verify POST /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/credit-terms creates a new credit term with name and dueDays returning 201; returns 409 if duplicate name exists; returns 403 if lacking Manage permission.

title: put_api_organizations_organizationid_configuration_credit_terms_id_updates_credit_term_and_handles_conflicts
description: Verify PUT /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/credit-terms/{id} updates name, dueDays, and isActive returning 200; returns 404 if not found; returns 409 if duplicate name conflict.

title: delete_api_organizations_organizationid_configuration_credit_terms_id_deletes_credit_term
description: Verify DELETE /api/organizations/{organizationId}/configuration/credit-terms/{id} deletes the credit term returning 204; returns 404 if not found.
